notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. Governing document: Faculty Handbook, Revised April 2017, captured 2018-02-22; it covers tenured and tenure-eligible faculty in every school (III.D.1.a eligibility: full-time continuing appointments). The HR page (undated, captured 2018-02-17) summarises the same plan and is used only for corroboration.

Birth parent chain: disability leave for pregnancy (c1, paid by c2) and infant care leave (c3), combined at most 120 calendar days and within a single semester per birth (leave_limits) → unpaid leave of up to one semester (c5, or the one-semester parental care leave c6 in lieu) → further discretionary unpaid illness leave (c11, no length).

Non-birth parent chain: infant care leave (c3) if the primary caregiver, or family care leave for the birth parent (c4), within the same 120-day / single-semester limits → unpaid leave of up to one semester (c5 or c6).

No document names FMLA or any statute relied on for a leave; the FMLA floor applies by U7. Statutes named in the handbook (ADEA, FERPA, 18 U.S.C. 16, Virginia FOIA, Va. Code 23-44, 2.2-3806, 2.2-3106) are unrelated (C4 not_components).

U8 paths: the HR page says eligible employees 'may elect' the university sick and disability plan (ORP participants enrolled automatically), and that employees choosing the Virginia Retirement Plan may enrol in VSDP (sick, family and personal leave; short-term and long-term disability; one-year waiting period for short- and long-term disability) instead of the College's long-term disability plan. The handbook (governing) states the faculty entitlement to the 120-day plan, so that path is coded; VSDP's terms are not saved (VSDP Handbook cited, not saved).

Not components: Scheduled Semester Research Leave, other academic leave and educational leave (purpose: scholarly or teaching development); unpaid leave or reduced responsibility leave to pursue professional or political activities (III.D.3.e; purpose unrelated to a birth); continuation of insurance and retirement contributions for faculty receiving at least 50% of salary (a benefits rule, not leave).

Cross-references found but not saved: the long-term disability insurance policy; VSDP Handbook; Professional Handbook (administrative and professional faculty); 'Academic Leave Without Pay or At Reduced Pay'; 'Scheduled Semester Research Leave Policy'; 'Faculty Retirement and Return to Work Policy'; 'Policy on Joint Appointments'; Policies and Procedures Regarding Employment and Performance Review of Administrative and Professional Faculty.

c5 reading: 'Requests for unpaid leave beyond the 120 day entitlement require the approval of the Provost' is read as leave beyond the unpaid entitlement (the one-semester entitlement equals 120 calendar days for non-instructional faculty in the Parental Care Leave paragraph); flagged ambiguous.

Single-semester limit: 'instructional faculty leave must be taken during a single semester for a single pregnancy/birth' is recorded as a 16-week leave limit on the paid disability and dependent care leaves (c1-c4), the leaves named in the same sentence; it is not applied to the separate unpaid semester (c5/c6), which the handbook grants 'In addition to the paid leave'.
